Promptly after any public announcement regarding any proposed transaction that would result in a Change in Circumstances, Buyer shall notify Seller, in writing, of the nature of such transaction, the parties thereto and the proposed date of consummation. If Seller elects to exercise any of its rights under the preceding paragraph, Seller shall so notify Buyer, in writing, within forty-five (45) days after receipt of Buyer's notice.
